name: Instagram Shopping checkout / link-out fee refresh (2026)
what_it_does: Native Instagram Checkout still widely cited at 5% selling fee (or $0.40 min on ≤$8). Much 2026 IG commerce is link-out to merchant checkout (no Meta selling fee; merchant pays own processor/platform). Reinforces first_party_pct_fee / Shop ~6% teach — not a new KEEP signal.
how_competitors_use_it: DTC brands split: in-app Checkout where available vs catalog + website close; TikTok Shop stays in-app with ~6% referral.
what_we_use_today: KEEP grader social_fee_pct=6 (Shop); social_shop + first_party_pct_fee signals; IG buy-now scripts assume Shop-class or merchant-owned close
gap: Secondary sources disagree on whether Meta still collects 5% vs retired checkout — treat 5% as watch when native Checkout enabled; prefer Shop ~6% or merchant link-out math in SalesLeads
summary: IG native checkout ~5% still cited; link-out path often $0 Meta selling fee — reinforce Never86 Shop/own-checkout KEEP, do not change grader default.
operator_ask: No action beyond auth unlocks; keep social_fee_pct=6 until Shop hike confirmed.
